info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Warehouse Inventory Locations-v1-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Location Retrieval API provides a streamlined method for fetching detailed information on inventory locations within a warehouse. This API enables logistics professionals and inventory managers to access location data efficiently, supporting inventory tracking and management operations. Users can retrieve comprehensive lists of all available inventory locations to inform restocking decisions and optimize space utilization. Ideal for integration into warehouse management systems, this API enhances operational visibility across logistics workflows.

get.summary: Retrieve the list of inventory locations.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve all available inventory locations, providing essential information about where products are stored. You can use this data for managing inventory and ensuring efficient logistics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving inventory location information. This body contains the necessary parameters and data structure required to make a GET request for inventory locations.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the inventory location data.
